workbook-12-03-xbox-adaptive-controller.subject: Xbox Adaptive controller, which is a large white rectangular slab with a few basic controls, mostly for Xbox console system functions, and multiple ports for accessible input devices. The controller itself consists of a white plastic slab with a slight slope from back to front; the right side of the controller is taken up by two large black dome buttons which default to controller inputs A and B; the left side of the controller has (from back to front) an Xbox system button, the View and Menu buttons, a button to switch between one of three saved mapping profiles, and a cross or plus-shaped digital directional pad.
